items.example: They built a wooden raft and left Peru in April.
They crossed the Pacific in one hundred and one days.
While they were sailing, huge waves crashed into the raft.
After a long journey they arrived in Polynesia.

items.idiom: write a book about the journey
items.example: He later wrote a book about the journey across the ocean.
I was riding my motorbike when it started to rain.
I was reading when I started to feel tired and fell asleep.
